guesses.reason: Broad blocky head, wide muzzle with pronounced cheeks, muscular stocky build, and fawn-and-white coat are classic pit bull–type traits.
Compact, deep-chested body with a short glossy coat and strong jaw closely matches the AmStaff type.
The large upright natural ears and slightly fuller, darker-shaded muzzle hint at some Boxer or other mixed influence.

breed.appearance: A medium, stocky, muscular dog with a short, smooth fawn (light tan) coat and a white blaze running from the forehead down the muzzle, spreading into a white chest and white paws. Her very large, upright, natural ears are pink inside, set high on a broad head, and she has amber-hazel eyes with soft gray shading around them and on the muzzle, a black nose, and pink freckled patches on the upper lips. She wears a pink collar with a silver tag and sits looking up attentively on an orange leash.
breed.fun_fact: Pit bull–type dogs are famously affectionate people-lovers who often think they're lap dogs, no matter their size!
